title: Population measurements without automatic development-station placement
acceptance_criteria: Does the isolated population server explicitly omit automatic development-station generation while preserving real authenticated join and committed body control?
What route reuse, collision work, tick/frame and separate JVM GC evidence accompanies visible parrot and mixed populations on the isolated flat fixture?

checks.rationale: Lead-owned isolated real-client 100-parrot capture. Require explicit station-builder opt-out evidence and retained matching join/commit/control/first-intent proof. Automatic station placement obstructed all R34 candidates. Existing bounded preflight, ownership admission and native limits remain unchanged. R34 already passed all four focused native route equivalence/work-reduction/freshness fixtures; do not redundantly rerun them here.
covers: Does the isolated population server explicitly omit automatic development-station generation while preserving real authenticated join and committed body control?
What route reuse, collision work, tick/frame and separate JVM GC evidence accompanies visible parrot and mixed populations on the isolated flat fixture?

checks.rationale: 40 animals, eight each bat/kobold/parrot/hamster/cow. Capture actual rendering, route requests/hits/computations and collision work after real committed ownership. No body/camera teleport or alternate admission flow. Normal station bootstrap remains default outside population fixtures. Removing the station changes baseline geometry/tick workload: these results alone cannot establish a controlled before/after timing improvement over R33. Short stationary captures do not establish prolonged growth, physical jumping/movement, native visual quality, manual readiness or owner acceptance. Retain exact failures and partial artifacts.
